title: Man Trespassing On Private Property Thinks He’s Above The Law
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 24th, 2023. Officers responded to a call about a man who was trespassing on private property and refusing to leave. When the officer tried to question him about what he was doing and why he was there, he could not give a straight answer and he kept trying to talk his way out of it. It was said that the man was intoxicated. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
